description: Notes passed to Stand while someone is asking it a question. Stand should let the person finish, and then answer using the note. Run with --talk poc/heckler/short-talk.md.

after.label: answer passed early in the question
after.say: Do you remember roughly how many people came to the workshop that was held last spring?
after.noteDuring: The workshop last spring had sixty-two people.

after.label: answer passed late in the question
after.say: I was also wondering which city the next offsite is going to be held in, if that has been decided.
after.noteDuring: The next offsite is in Lisbon.

after.label: instruction passed during a question
after.say: And could you tell us what the price is going to be for a team of about twenty people?
after.noteDuring: Do not give a price. Say Morgan will send a proposal on Friday.

goodbye.label: goodbye
goodbye.say: That's everything from us. Thank you.
